anchors.description: Width of the black built-in dishwasher front face, left vertical edge to right vertical edge at mid-door height
anchors.visible_evidence: Black glossy under-counter appliance front is fully visible between the wood drawer stack on its left and the wood cabinet door on its right; both front edges are crisp vertical boundaries in the counter run.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Fascia proportions and 34-in front height match a standard 24-in wide built-in dishwasher; a compact 18-in unit would be noticeably narrower than the adjacent door.

anchors.description: Vertical clearance from the bottom front edge of the left upper cabinet run down to the granite countertop directly beneath it
anchors.visible_evidence: Upper cabinet underside front edge runs at y~161 across the left run; at this column the granite countertop is fully visible from backsplash joint to front edge, and the point sits at mid-counter depth directly under the cabinet face.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard 18-in gap between upper cabinets and countertop; installations range 17-19 in, and the mid-depth placement of the counter point carries about +/-0.05 m of depth error.

anchors.description: Vertical rise from the tile floor at the dishwasher toe kick up to the countertop front edge above it
anchors.visible_evidence: Countertop front edge (top of the black dishwasher front) and the bright tile floor directly below at the appliance base are both visible in the same image column; the counter edge line and the toe-kick line are unambiguous.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard 36-in countertop height (34.5-in base cabinet plus 1.5-in counter); the floor point lies a few centimetres in front of the recessed toe kick, which can inflate the straight-line distance by up to ~5 cm.

anchors.description: Height of the black electric kettle on the counter, from its base on the granite to the top of the lid/handle arch
anchors.visible_evidence: Black kettle stands on the granite at image left with its spout and handle silhouette against the light backsplash; base contact and the top of the handle are both crisp against the bright background.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Read as a typical 1.7-L electric kettle (24-28 cm overall with handle); if it is instead a taller thermal carafe or a lower jug kettle the height would differ by roughly 3-5 cm.
